text:
Cost of operating has been far exceeding rent roll increases for about 8 years now.  The value of these multi-family are down around 70%.  All the developer friends I speak with refuse to build new housing, the economics dont work, and that's for non regulated housing too.

So no, it has ZERO to do with the mayor and more about if you're trying to solve housing affordability this is the opposite of what needs to be done.
